summary: Create, edit and save Grafana dashboards to a GitHub repo using Git Sync, via direct commit and pull request.

needs.description: Git Sync configured on the stack (Provisioning) with a connected GitHub repo, branch 'main', and a provisioned folder (path 'dashboards') shown with a Provisioned label in the Save drawer.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: Git Sync configured with a connected GitHub repository; save-dashboard-git: select your Git Sync provisioned folder

needs.description: GitHub repository with write access via Git Sync auth (GitHub App/PAT) allowing commits to main and PR branches; learner needs GitHub account access (view-changes-github step).
needs.evidence: Before you begin: GitHub account with access to the connected repository; save-with-pr: Open pull request in GitHub

needs.description: A Prometheus data source selectable in the new-panel data source picker (code-mode query).
User able to create/edit dashboards and save to provisioned folder (Editor/Admin).
needs.evidence: Before you begin: appropriate permissions to manage dashboards

reviewNotes: Whether the repo/Git Sync config can be pre-seeded on the shared stack and how PR/commit steps are tested (they push to a real GitHub repo) needs a decision. Stack must have Git Sync feature enabled.
